summary.text: Mike Azinger is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 3 since 2016 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the House of Delegates from 2014 to 2016 and chairs the Senate Banking and Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike Azinger represented House of Delegates District 10 from 2014 to 2016 before taking office in the State Senate in 2016.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Banking and Insurance Committee and also serves on the Confirmations, Education, Energy, Industry and Mining, Health and Human Resources, and Judiciary committees.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
